protocol: fixed descriptive XLSX producer full-cell release baseline

source_review.timing_scope: fresh SourceBackedWorkbook open, worksheet enumeration, Rect::ALL stored-cell visits, and callback digest

verified: The frozen schedule uses 12 native children with 3 warmups and 30 samples each, followed by 6 allocator children with 3 warmups and 15 samples each; every child is a fresh process pinned with /usr/bin/taskset to CPU 12.

Native and allocator binaries are release artifacts with explicit feature, size, SHA-256, retained-path, source-revision, and build-descriptor bindings; capture uses a minimal fixed child environment and fails before the next child on exit or semantic evidence failure.

The verifier recomputes per-child floored-midpoint p50 and nearest-rank p95/p99 from retained raw vectors, requires a sample-index permutation and aligned scan/operation vectors, and retains every row without retries or replacements.

The semantic fences check the archive, cell counts, canonical digest, worksheet refusal census, source-version stability, route flags, producer sidecar, process-lifetime peak RSS scope, and allocator positivity with zero failed calls.

The helper checks pass, including non-identity sample-order alignment, raw-statistic recomputation, allocator rejection behavior, full worksheet census, debug-profile rejection, and single-pass capture behavior. Freeze requires these checks and this review before any child launch.
caveats: This packet is descriptive only: it makes no candidate comparison, speedup, adoption, or performance decision claim.
CPU affinity is recorded without an exclusive host guarantee; unrelated host load can widen observed variation, and the native p50 spread flag above 1.20 is retained for inspection.

The workload is a warm in-memory generated producer XLSX using an owned positional ReadAt source. It carries no physical-cold-cache or native Office runtime claim; allocator elapsed values are a separate instrumented observation.

The source snapshot and source archive are retained for reconstruction. Rebuilding from the exact revision and toolchain does not promise byte-identical binaries, so the packet binds the captured executable hashes as well.
required_followups: Freeze only after build.json reports pass and helper-checks.json reports exit_code 0; then retain the plan, commands, receipts, stdout/stderr, reports, evidence sidecars, and raw vectors.
After archive and verification, remove only the owned build/source scratch roots and generated Python cache files; do not reuse old 0882 timings.
